scope: Locked adaptive cached screen on the same 4977 Okutama centers; repeated-development evidence, not external confirmation

arms.c1_class_diagonal_protected_residual: three classwise log-residual coefficients learned on selected outer-training OOF predictions

equation: softmax(log(p_M4 + epsilon) + alpha[class] * (log(p_A3 + epsilon) - log(p_M4 + epsilon)))

optimization.fits: exactly one three-coefficient fit per outer fold; five fits total

sitting_protection.rule: If M4 and A3 predicted classes disagree and either prediction is sitting, return the exact M4 probability bytes

splitting.training_probabilities: fold-selected inner OOF M4 and A3 predictions covering only outer-training scenarios
splitting.inference_probabilities: fold-selected M4 and A3 outer refits paired in fixed seed order [42, 43, 44]
splitting.outer_metric_embargo: No outer-held label, correctness flag, or metric is read, scored, or logged until all five fold receipts validate

forbidden: scenario or fold identity as a model feature

exact_scenario_swap_test.alternative: candidate macro-F1 improvement over exact M4

screen_gate.wording: This is a strict go/no-go cached screen for investment in transported temporal parts; it is not confirmation and a failure cannot be rescued by post-hoc arm selection.

interpretation.adaptive_status: The architecture and sitting protection were motivated after inspecting M4 and A3 on this cohort.
interpretation.claim_limit: Results quantify development utility only and cannot establish unbiased generalization.
interpretation.held_release_rule: The primary definition and hashes are frozen before this runner releases any new candidate metric.
